The '''Lumbridge church''', referred to in-game as the ''' Church of Holy Saradomin''' by [[Father Aereck]], is the official church of [[Lumbridge]]. The church is the starting place for the [[Restless Ghost]] [[quest]], and also contains the [[Prayer tutor]]. There's a playable [[Church organ|organ]] behind the [[altar]].

According to Father Aereck, the church was built over 230 years ago.
